items.title: Natty Dominique Interview, 1958-05-31
items.q: Mr. Raggio's room, that's the principal. You understand that?

ctx.x: Mary Lee's school. That's on Mary Lee between Oakwood and Vilry. Her name is Lizzie Landry. Her and I was together in this room. Riley's room, the teacher. And Mr. Raggio's room, that's the principal. You understand that? And we used to talk a lot. But I never knew Lizzie could sing. I never knew her sing. I took her to Chicago. I found out she could sing. But when she came to Chicago, she was married to that Pajot boy. That was her husband. He was running on the road. Then she left. And when Lizzie come back,…
She still uses that name. Pajot? Pajot. I never met him. She still uses that name. He's famous.
